prompt: Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Work Sans; warm expressive serif with open functional sans. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 14px, heading 64px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
